places.why: The national map does not draw 버들골 풍산마당. OpenStreetMap does.
The national map does not draw 데이터사이언스대학원. OpenStreetMap does.
The national map draws 종합운동장본부석 only as a wall-less structure, which the seed leaves out.
The polygon that holds the position of 화학관연결동 has no label and is another structure.
The national map labels a second polygon, B0010000000RF2EB9 at 국제대학원, as 104-1동. It stands 1 km from 반도체교육관.
The national map labels the four parts of 500동 as 501동 to 504동. The campus map counts them as 500동.
